    ∃ f : ArithmeticFunction ℝ,

      f.IsMultiplicative ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → 0 < f n) ∧
      (∀ p : ℕ, Nat.Prime p →
        StrictMono (fun m : ℕ => f (p ^ m)) ∨
        StrictAnti (fun m : ℕ => f (p ^ m))) := by
  let f : ArithmeticFunction ℝ :=
    ⟨fun n : ℕ => Real.rpow (n : ℝ) ε, by simpa using Real.zero_rpow hε⟩
  refine ⟨f, fun n => rfl, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · constructor
    · simpa only [f, ArithmeticFunction.coe_mk, Nat.cast_one, Real.rpow_eq_pow]
        using Real.one_rpow ε
    · intro m n hmn
      change Real.rpow ((m * n : ℕ) : ℝ) ε =
        Real.rpow (m : ℝ) ε * Real.rpow (n : ℝ) ε
      simp only [Nat.cast_mul, Real.rpow_eq_pow]
      exact Real.mul_rpow (Nat.cast_nonneg m) (Nat.cast_nonneg n)
  · intro n hn
    exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by exact_mod_cast hn) ε
  · intro p hp
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hε with hneg | hpos
    · right
      intro m n hmn
      apply Real.rpow_lt_rpow_of_neg
        (by exact_mod_cast pow_pos hp.pos m)
        (by exact_mod_cast Nat.pow_lt_pow_right hp.one_lt hmn) hneg
    · left
      intro m n hmn
      apply Real.rpow_lt_rpow (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
        (by exact_mod_cast Nat.pow_lt_pow_right hp.one_lt hmn) hpos
